summary: Titan Mining Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release solely announcing the date and logistics for its Q2 2026 earnings release and conference call scheduled for August 12, 2026. The filing contains no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, activist campaign, or management change. It is a routine earnings notification and quarterly update call notice typical for foreign private issuers. No financial terms, transaction details, or strategic actions are mentioned, and the forward-looking statements relate to routine operations and development. Consequently, this does not qualify as a special situation; it is an ordinary operational communication.
